plain_words: A synthetic 4000-neuron directed network whose excitatory/inhibitory labels and four E/I connection-class densities+weight magnitudes are matched to FlyWire CX statistics (stochastic block model; no copied edges). Neurons get cortical-like layers; each neuron's myelin fraction is drawn from the real H01 distribution for that layer, then edge delays follow the same myelin→delay map used in the human patch (more myelin → shorter delay). Weak spectral tempering keeps the bulk of large eigenvalues from filling like an ER graph.
